{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.5.3), upper-left horizontal arrow",
      "scan": "\\mathbf{L}^{+}\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}",
      "tex": "\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\ar[r]^{\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}}",
        "new": "\\ar[r]^{\\mathbf{L}^{+}\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}}"
      },
      "note": "The edition systematically suppresses the left-derived-functor symbol, transferring G to the pullback notation where applicable. This is a representative edit; three examples are given in coordinator."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.5.3), right-hand middle vertex",
      "scan": "D^{+}(R,\\Oo_R)",
      "tex": "D^{+}F(R,\\Oo_R)",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "& D^{+}F(R,\\Oo_R)\\\\",
        "new": "& D^{+}(R,\\Oo_R)\\\\"
      },
      "note": "The target of Gr_i is the unfiltered derived category; the printed vertex has no F."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Composition defining the spectral functor, immediately below the diagram",
      "scan": "{}_F\\RR^{+}(\\overline{H\\circ\\theta})_{\\ast}",
      "tex": "{}_F R(\\bar{H \\circ \\theta})_{\\ast}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "{}_F R(\\bar{H \\circ \\theta})_{\\ast}",
        "new": "{}_F \\RR^{+}(\\bar{H \\circ \\theta})_{\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The printed derived functor has the superscript +. Unlike the diagram, this occurrence has no sisi recording that reading."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Proposition 2.5.6, introductory sentence",
      "scan": "spectral précédant",
      "tex": "spectral précédant",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "spectral précédent",
      "note": "The adjective should be « précédent ». The TeX keeps the printed misspelling."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Final paragraph, after « toutes les considérations précédentes »",
      "scan": "vont se transcrirent",
      "tex": "vont se transcrire",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "vont se transcrire",
      "note": "The print erroneously ends the infinitive with « nt ». The TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Final paragraph, placement of the index G",
      "scan": "en indice partant ou cela a un sens",
      "tex": "en indice partant ou cela a un sens",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "en indice partout où cela a un sens",
      "note": "« partant » should be « partout », and the locative relative is « où ». The TeX keeps both printed errors."
    },
    {
      "page": 121,
      "where": "Final sentence",
      "scan": "Les détails sont laissés aux soins du lecteur",
      "tex": "Les détails sont laissés au soin du lecteur",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "au soin du lecteur",
        "new": "aux soins du lecteur"
      },
      "note": "The print uses the plural « aux soins »."
    },
    {
      "page": 122,
      "where": "Proposition 2.5.7, augmentation symbol",
      "scan": "\\theta : X \\to C^D_S",
      "tex": "\\mathcal{O} : X \\to C^D_S",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$\\mathcal{O} : X \\to C^D_S$",
        "new": "$\\theta : X \\to C^D_S$"
      },
      "note": "The printed augmentation is theta, as in the formulas that follow, not a script O."
    },
    {
      "page": 122,
      "where": "Proposition 2.5.7, spectral-sequence abutment arrow",
      "scan": "\\Rightarrow R^{p+q}_G h_{\\ast}",
      "tex": "\\to R^{p + q}_G h_{\\ast}",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\to R^{p + q}_G h_{\\ast}",
        "new": "\\Rightarrow R^{p + q}_G h_{\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The print has a double convergence arrow, not a single arrow."
    },
    {
      "page": 122,
      "where": "Condition (3.0.0)",
      "scan": "et des familles de",
      "tex": "et sont des familles de",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "et sont des familles de",
        "new": "et des familles de"
      },
      "note": "The second « sont » is not printed."
    },
    {
      "page": 122,
      "where": "Definition of the truncated categories, before (3.0.1.1)",
      "scan": "la sous-catégorie pleine ... formés par les objets",
      "tex": "la sous-catégorie pleine ... formés par les objets",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "formée par les objets",
      "note": "The participle must agree with « la sous-catégorie ». The TeX keeps the printed « formés »."
    },
    {
      "page": 123,
      "where": "First paragraph, final occurrence of the right adjoint",
      "scan": "i_{n\\ast}",
      "tex": "i_{n_\\ast}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "i_{n_\\ast}",
        "new": "i_{n\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The printed star accompanies n in the index of i; the TeX instead nests it as a subscript of n."
    },
    {
      "page": 123,
      "where": "Definition of Delta_{n[p]}, before (3.0.1.2)",
      "scan": "la sous-catégorie pleine \\Delta_{[p]}",
      "tex": "la sous-catégorie pleine\n$\\Delta_{[p]}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "la sous-catégorie pleine de $\\Delta_{[p]}$",
      "note": "The print omits « de »: the truncated category is a full subcategory of Delta_{[p]}. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 123,
      "where": "Diagram in (3.0.2.2), common right-hand target",
      "scan": "\\Hom_E(X_p,X'_p)",
      "tex": "\\Hom_E(X_p,X'_p)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Hom_E(X_p,X'_n)",
      "note": "The second index must be n: both paths give a morphism from X_p to X'_n. The TeX keeps the printed wrong index."
    },
    {
      "page": 123,
      "where": "N.B., second line",
      "scan": "on peut palier à cet inconvénient",
      "tex": "on peut palier à\ncet inconvénient",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "on peut pallier cet inconvénient",
      "note": "The print has « palier à » instead of « pallier ». The TeX keeps the printed wording."
    },
    {
      "page": 124,
      "where": "Lemma 3.0.2.4, category containing X and X'",
      "scan": "\\Delta_n^{\\circ}E",
      "tex": "\\Delta^{\\circ}E",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$\\Delta^{\\circ}E$",
        "new": "$\\Delta_n^{\\circ}E$"
      },
      "note": "The printed category is n-truncated; its subscript n is missing from the TeX."
    },
    {
      "page": 124,
      "where": "Proof of Lemma 3.0.2.4, index of the projective limit",
      "scan": "q \\geq n",
      "tex": "q \\geq n",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "q \\leq n",
      "note": "The extension from the n-truncated objects must use the already defined degrees q <= n. The TeX keeps the printed reversed inequality."
    },
    {
      "page": 124,
      "where": "Proposition 3.1.1, labels of the two augmentation arrows",
      "scan": "X \\xrightarrow{n} C^D_S,\\quad X'\\xrightarrow{n'} C^D_S",
      "tex": "X \\xrightarrow{u} C^D_S,\\quad X'\\xrightarrow{u'} C^D_S",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "X \\xrightarrow{u} C^D_S,\\quad X'\\xrightarrow{u'} C^D_S",
      "note": "The printed arrow labels read n and n', whereas the ensuing formula uses u and u'. The TeX silently corrects the labels."
    },
    {
      "page": 124,
      "where": "Proposition 3.1.1, last factor on the right of eta_G^f",
      "scan": "\\mathbf{L}^{+}\\bar{u}^{\\ast}",
      "tex": "\\bar{u}_G^{\\ast}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\mathbf{L}_G^{+}\\bar{u}^{\\ast}",
      "note": "The print omits G on this L, although it is present on the corresponding left-hand factor and in the following page's diagram. The edition's G-indexed pullback notation silently corrects the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 125,
      "where": "Functor-category Hom symbols, especially (3.1.1.2)",
      "scan": "\\underline{\\Hom}((I\\times D)^{\\circ},B/S)",
      "tex": "\\Hom((I \\times D)^{\\circ}, B/S)",
      "kind": "font",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Hom((I \\times D)^{\\circ}, B/S)",
        "new": "\\underline{\\Hom}((I \\times D)^{\\circ}, B/S)"
      },
      "note": "The print underlines categorical Hom, distinguishing it from the un-underlined morphism sets on page 123. This is a representative edit for the convention; three examples are given in coordinator."
    },
    {
      "page": 125,
      "where": "Introduction of the category I",
      "scan": "la catégorie définie par le type de diagramme",
      "tex": "la catégorie définie par le graphe",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "la catégorie définie par le graphe",
        "new": "la catégorie définie par le type de diagramme"
      },
      "note": "The edition substitutes « graphe » for the printed phrase."
    },
    {
      "page": 125,
      "where": "Isomorphism (3.1.1.2), right-hand side",
      "scan": "\\Hom(I^{\\circ},\\Hom(D^{\\circ},B/S))",
      "tex": "\\Hom(I^{0},\\Hom(D^0,B/S))",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Hom(I^{0},\n\\Hom (D^0, B/S))",
        "new": "\\Hom(I^{\\circ},\n\\Hom (D^{\\circ}, B/S))"
      },
      "note": "Both printed superscripts are opposite-category circles, as on the left-hand side, rather than numerical zeros."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "121: 4/3; 122: 3/1; 123: 1/3; 124: 1/3; 125: 3/0 (normal/misprint).\nConvention—restore suppressed left-derived symbols throughout these pages; the fix is representative. Three examples (print → TeX): p.121 (2.5.5.3), L^+\\bar\\theta^* → \\bar\\theta^*; p.122 E_1, L_G^+\\theta_p^* → \\theta_{p,G}^*; p.124 eta_G^f, L_G^+\\bar u'^* → {\\bar u'}_G^*.\nConvention—categorical Hom loses its printed underline; the fix is representative. Three examples on p.125: Hom(\\Delta^\\circ,B/S) in the opening paragraph; the left-hand Hom in (3.1.1.2); the inner Hom(D^\\circ,B/S) in (3.1.1.2)."
}
